scope: Held-shape background preservation; triangle and rotated rectangle fitting. No UI, data-format or authentication changes.

cause.background: PaperView is a child of PKCanvasView. The previous held preview set canvas.layer.opacity=0 and showed ink only, hiding paper/PDF too.
cause.triangle: ShapeKind and candidate generation had no triangle branch.
cause.rectangle: The minimum enclosing box was biased by outward edge wobble. A deterministic 160x80 rectangle with an 8-unit localized bulge was rejected by the old fitter; the new edge-line fit accepts it without relaxing residual thresholds.

replacement: Reuse immutable cached paper tile CGImages at the native viewport transform underneath transparent fitted ink; prepare before the atomic visibility switch, remove after native rendering. No full-page background snapshot or forced white fill.
recognition: Bounded convex-hull corner proposals, interior edge PCA fits and intersections, normalized finite-segment residuals, corner/edge coverage, single traversal, area and orthogonality checks; short terminal excursions require prior loop closure. Compare eligible polygon/curve confidence. Existing native corner controls now also cover triangles.

backgroundRendering.tolerance: Max channel delta 24/255 at isolated edges; global mean <0.1/255. No extra paper tile rasterizations on snap. Old controller fails this same check.
backgroundRendering.note: The app has no separate colored-paper style. Colored backgrounds are tested through its existing PDF support.

liveUITests.runtimeWarnings: 3 Publishing changes from within view updates warnings; also present in the prior fixture run. Unrelated UI was not modified.

deviceTargetBuild.command: xcodebuild -quiet -project /Users/whans/Documents/IPAD/NoteMargin.xcodeproj -scheme NoteMargin -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination generic/platform=iOS -derivedDataPath /private/tmp/NoteMargin-engine-device-build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

validation.physicalApplePencil: Not tested. Live UI uses real simulator finger touch events with a DEBUG-only Pencil observer opt-in; curved/polygon hold input is injected through the same controller in deterministic fixtures.
validation.latency: Pure fitting CPU timings only; no physical Pencil input-to-display measurement.
